title: A planned goal's figure about recorded benchmark rows is read from benchmarks.csv, not stated from memory
goal: Planning reads each figure a goal states about recorded benchmark rows (a sample size, a rank, a recorded value) from kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv with the command beside it in the item's notes, so a claim such as BG-v5f5tn5y's 'the recorded n=44 run is unaffected' (the 2026-10-12 freshness run has n=54 and its p95 moved from rank 51 to 52) is caught before the start, not by the review (SP-e4fm2ovk review gap 2)

run:
import sys
t = open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read().splitlines()
ok = any('benchmarks.csv' in ln and 'goal' in ln and ('sample size' in ln or 'rank' in ln) and 'recorded' in ln for ln in t)
print('clause found:', ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
